lead.title: Builder's remedy bill SB 457 fails to advance from the Senate Housing Committee
lead.summary: A measure to narrow how the builder's remedy can be used against cities that miss their housing element deadlines did not clear its first policy committee, leaving the remedy's reach unchanged for Bay Area cities out of compliance.

spans.v: April 2025 brought 10 items onto the public record across the nine counties
, 7 of them about housing or development
The largest of them came from Sacramento.
Builder's remedy bill SB 457 fails to advance from the Senate Housing Committee
Office of Senator Josh Becker
Zillow publishes an index for 100 of the region's 101 cities and towns. The median typical home among them is $1.27M in the 2024 reading
, and the median asking rent $3,106
One decision this period was taken above the level of any single city.
Builder's remedy bill SB 457 fails to advance from the Senate Housing Committee

A measure to narrow how the builder's remedy can be used against cities that miss their housing element deadlines did not clear its first policy committee, leaving the remedy's reach unchanged for Bay Area cities out of compliance.
Office of Senator Josh Becker
San Mateo County produced 5 items this period, more than anywhere else
, with Santa Clara next at 4
Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, Solano and Sonoma published nothing in the same window.
Land use in all 101 of these jurisdictions is decided in public, by a planning commission and then a city or town council, on an agenda posted days beforehand at a meeting where anyone may speak.
Three items this period turned on that kind of meeting, including
Santa Clara approves another 1,000+ housing project
in Santa Clara,
Santa Clara County housing gets approved, but not built
in Santa Clara,
Plans Approved For 40 Airport Boulevard, South San Francisco
in South San Francisco.
The median typical home across the tracked cities was $1.27M in the 2024 index
, 7.7% above the same reading a year earlier
. The range behind that median is wide: Atherton at $7.18M and Rio Vista at $476,177, a difference of 15.1 times between two cities about an hour apart.
Published records that are not yet reported as finished add up to 3 developments carrying 7,579 reported homes
: 3 approved
. The largest is
Downtown West / Diridon Station
in San Jose at 4,000 homes, so a single master plan can account for much of a county's total.
Six housing stories came out of the cities themselves, and 4 of them are set out here.
In Los Gatos,
Housing project next to Los Gatos High raises safety issues
A 30-home project could be built across the street from Los Gatos High School, bringing student safety to the forefront.
(San José Spotlight, April 6, 2025.)
Over in Santa Clara,
Santa Clara approves another 1,000+ housing project
North Santa Clara is slated for more than a thousand new homes over the next few years, with whole neighborhoods under construction.
(San José Spotlight, April 14, 2025.)
In Santa Clara,
Santa Clara County housing gets approved, but not built
Cities in Santa Clara County have approved hundreds of new homes, but construction hasn’t kept up, a data analysis by San José Spotlight shows.
(San José Spotlight, April 24, 2025.)
Over in Pacifica,
Preliminary Plans For Pacifica Quarry Residential Redevelopment, San Mateo County
Preliminary plans have been filed for Coastal Crest Residences, a potential residential redevelopment of the Pacifica Quarry Site by Rockaway Beach.
(SF YIMBY, April 25, 2025.)
